==Description==
'''C''' was an [[Enemies|enemy]] which only appeared in the [[Hidden Wave (Legacy)|Hidden Wave]] and therefore only appeared in [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode. As with the other lettered enemies in the game ([[A]] and [[B]]), it appeared after the [[Creator]] spawned.

'''C''' had a high amount of health and was very fast, faster than [[A]] and [[B]].

==Appearance==
'''C''' had black reflective skin, a white lab coat, and red granite torso and legs. This was similar in appearance to [[A]] and [[B]]. It was about the same size as the [[Abnormal]].

==Strategy==
*Because of its high health, high DPS towers like the [[Turret]], [[Minigunner]], [[Ranger]] and [[Accelerator]], are highly recommended.
**Additionally, [[Commander]] and [[DJ Booth]] should be used to boost said towers.
*Due to '''C's''' fast speed, you should use towers that slow enemies down, like the [[Electroshocker]], [[Sledger]], [[Freezer]], [[Frost Blaster]] or [[Toxic Gunner]].

==Trivia==
*This enemy was similar to [[A]] and [[B]] in terms of naming and appearance.
**Out of all lettered enemies, '''C''' had the highest amount of health and fastest speed.
*This enemy was similar to [[w:c:roblox-tower-battles:M|M]] and [[w:c:roblox-tower-battles:J|J]], from ''Tower Battles''.
